```yaml
name: Update Roadmap with Recent Merged PRs

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every day at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: # Allow manual trigger

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  update-roadmap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Fetch recent merged PRs
        id: fetch_prs
        run: |
          # Fetch the 10 most recent merged pull requests
          # We use the GitHub API to get this data
          PRS=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/sourcebot-dev/sourcebot/pulls?state=closed&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=100" | \
            jq -r '[.[] | select(.merged_at != null)] | .[0:10] | .[] | "- #" + (.number | tostring)')
          
          # Store the result in an environment variable for the next step
          echo "RECENT_PRS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "$PRS" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Update Roadmap File
        run: |
          # Define the file path
          ROADMAP_FILE=".github/workflows/_merge.yml"
          
          # Check if the file exists, if not, create it with a basic structure
          if [ ! -f "$ROADMAP_FILE" ]; then
            echo "# Sourcebot Roadmap" > "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "## 🚀 Released" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "10 most recent [merged PRs](https://github.com/sourcebot-dev/sourcebot/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged):" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "$RECENT_PRS" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "## 🔮 Planned" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "> \[!IMPORTANT\]" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "> Some of these items do not have issues. We're working on it 👷‍♂️🚧" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "### Code Search" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "* Unlimited branch support (#461)" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "* Zoekt search limit warning (#504)" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "### Ask SB" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "* 3rd party MCP server support" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "* Mermaid diagram support" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "* Automated eval test suite" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "* Integrated AI chat thread panel while browsing code (#476)" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "### Misc" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "* Inline git blame in code editor" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "* Branch / commit selector in `/browse`" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "* Sourcebot CLI" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "* \[EE\] Batch changes ([#403](https://github.com/sourcebot-dev/sourcebot/issues/403))" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "* Improved production deployment support (#439)" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "* Easier access to file explorer (#472)" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
            echo "* Universal fuzzy search (#536)" >> "$ROADMAP_FILE"
          else
            # If the file exists, update the "Released" section
            # We will replace the content between "## 🚀 Released" and "## 🔮 Planned"
            
            # Extract the part before "## 🚀 Released"
            BEFORE_RELEASED=$(sed -n '1,/^## 🚀 Released/p' "$ROADMAP_FILE" | head -n -1)
            
            # Extract the part after "## 🔮 Planned"
            AFTER_PLANNED=$(sed -n '/^## 🔮 Planned/,$p' "$ROADMAP_FILE")
            
            # Construct the new content
            NEW_CONTENT="${BEFORE_RELEASED}
## 🚀 Released

10 most recent [merged PRs](https://github.com/sourcebot-dev/sourcebot/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged):

${RECENT_PRS}

${AFTER_PLANNED}"
            
            # Write the new content to the file
            echo "$NEW_CONTENT" > "$ROADMAP_FILE"
          fi

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .github/workflows/_merge.yml
          git diff --quiet && git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "Update roadmap with recent merged PRs"
          git push
```
